verdict.rationale: The official docs cover PTO/time-off requests flowing into payroll (time-off-requests.md) but never mention hourly time entries or overtime calculation. The only signal for actual hourly timesheet flow is the third-party/GitHub CLI evidence showing a `gusto timesheet` command and a 'timesheet-sync' skill that 'drives the per-cycle timesheet input flow' feeding into payroll-prep drafts — but this doesn't explicitly confirm overtime rules or rate calculations being applied automatically. Missing for 10: official API/docs describing hourly time-entry endpoints, overtime rule computation, and independent confirmation that overtime correctly flows into a submitted payroll run.
